snippet.title: Bomberman Land: Battles Trailer
snippet.description: Fresh off his hit console game, Bomberman is back on mobile phones! Bomberman Land: Battles sports an all-new adventure mode with 32 huge maps that have branching paths combined with an upgrade system.  Choose your path carefully, as each of the 17 upgrades is unique to a specific path.  You'll have to use those upgrades wisely to win each of the 5 huge boss fights.  When you do defeat the bosses, you unlock them as opponents in VS. mode, in which you battle against other Bombermen! By Hudson.
